subject: 4MB1
skill: Factorise a monic quadratic with two distinct positive integer roots, using a pair of negative constants whose sum and product match its coefficients.

customQuiz.rationale: Retains source degree, leading coefficient, two distinct positive integer roots, command and two-mark scheme. New coefficients and exact-answer selection are subject to adaptation/difficulty review; no 4/6-mark variant is claimed.

requirements: Display only the expanded polynomial, with leading coefficient one, negative linear coefficient and positive constant.
Two distinct integer roots from 1 through 12; the generator excludes the source root pair 3,4.
evidenceContract: Freeze parameters, expanded coefficients, factorised solution and source rubric before any future serving.
Expose only prompt, expanded stimulus and maximum marks; roots, seed and rubric stay private.

constraints: smallerRoot < largerRoot; roots are distinct positive integers.
smallerRoot < largerRoot; roots are distinct positive integers.
No repeated/zero/negative/fractional roots, non-monic coefficients, cubic factorisation or solving equations in this version.
The 65 fresh parameter pairs are a bounded prototype, not a complete Maths question bank.
Never equate arithmetic coverage with calibrated exam demand or live eligibility.
difficultyControls: Vary sum/product magnitudes within the explicit domain; equal difficulty is not established.
Preserve the sign pattern and distinct linear factors of the source.

transformations.conditions: Use distinct roots in 1..12, excluding 3,4 for fresh generation; recalibrate coefficient size effects.
This task asks for factorisation, not an equation solution.

solutionProcedure: Find two constants with the required sum and product.
Expand to check all three original coefficients.

criteria.rule: A single alternative-score criterion: correct factorised product earns two; otherwise a factorisation with exactly two correct expanded terms earns one; other supported products earn zero.

acceptableAlternatives: Negate both linear factors, preserving the same product.
Other mathematically equivalent factorisations need representation review; unsupported syntax is deferred.
dependencies: Use the answer line when nonempty; otherwise the last nonempty line of working.
Do not award separate marks per correct bracket or choose the best earlier line.
contradictionRules: Additional evidence or unclear ordering is deferred.
A later supported answer supersedes an earlier correct working line under the source-specific rule.

commonErrors.description: A product giving only two correct expanded terms earns partial credit, not one mark per bracket.
Solving for x or copying the expanded polynomial does not supply the requested factorisation; these representations are deferred by the narrow parser.

testPlan: Exhaust the 65 fresh pairs and independently expand the produced factors.
Check original source and boundary fixtures against manually specified answers.
Score/defer explicit response fixtures including both-negative factors, incorrect later answers, unsupported scalars and unsafe strings.
Before promotion review empirical difficulty, notation breadth, all ambiguous responses and official AO applicability.

runtime.seedPolicy: Unsigned 32-bit seed selects one of 65 stable pairs by remainder. Seed is reproducibility metadata, not a secret or security control. Exclude original source pair from fresh generation.

blockers: Only a bounded offline two-binomial marker; not a general algebra or handwriting parser.
Independent learner-response calibration, broad notation handling and difficulty review remain pending.
Official per-task AO allocation unverified; two-mark-only family does not cover the full quiz blueprint.
